teachings.birds_per_lb_vs_month.png: Around month 6 a 40 lb P10 order needs about 2.5 starters per pound (N0 about 100) while F_prelim is still near 0.9 times spot. A shorter month burns starters. A much later month trims starters only a little and discounts the prepaid.
teachings.delivery_split_vs_soon.png: A book that can wait for part of the pounds needs fewer starters than shipping all of it in month 3.
teachings.ne_vs_sale.png: A quail sale that would leave Ne under 50 is refused.
teachings.quail_inbreeding_leakage.png: More full-sib offspring lowers hatch and viability on the Sato slopes.
teachings.quail_n0_for_2000.png: About 2,816 starters hold $2,000 a month from month 2 on the P10 tail.
teachings.quail_feed_vs_herd.png: Worm and plant feed rise with the heavy herd; a short ration fails closed.
teachings.worm_p10_sell_room.png: Worm P10 room grows with the starting herd and with a later month.
